attributes.action: Government to investigate and explain the Gosport incident and costings
attributes.additional_details: In Gosport, Hampshire this week, the state provided an unprecedented welcome to foreign illegal migrants to Gosport. While at the same time using road blocks and diversions within the whole town demanding locals go home and stopping free travel within their own town. While providing Emergency vehicles and hundreds of emergency workers including police officers to assist these illegals in getting to their hotels without delays or interactions with UK citizens.
attributes.background: As a free nation the UK has for years welcomed foreign migrants to come here to live work and integrate into our society. These last few years things are different. The UK government seem dead set on creating division in our culture culminating with a protection force escorting unknowns to hotels.

rejection.details:
We can’t accept petitions that call for action at a local level.

You could ask your MP to take action on your concerns about this issue, including by asking them to present a public (paper) petition about this.

You can find contact details for your local MP here: https://members.parliament.uk/FindYourMP

And you can find out how to ask your MP to present a public (paper) petition here: https://www.parliament.uk/get-involved/sign-a-petition/paper-petitions/

You could also raise your issue with a local councillor who represents you. You can use this page to find out who your local councillors are, and how to contact them: https://www.gov.uk/find-your-local-councillors
